statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail is elevated because NQ has remained near the session low after reversing from the session high, with oil, VIX and Treasury yields adding aligned pressure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. The elevated state is evidence-based and can fall quickly if NQ repairs away from the low and directional efficiency weakens.
headline: Nasdaq Tail turns elevated as futures hold near the session low
body: Delayed NQ was 29,559.75, only 9.25 points above the 29,550.50 session low after opening at the 29,739.00 session high. WTI was about 3.1% higher, VIX about 2.9% higher and the U.S. 10-year yield near 4.80%. Strong semiconductors conflict with weak megacap breadth, limiting conviction beyond the elevated band.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock-hours are available. Tail ranged 17%-24% and Stress remained 100%; the published mode moved from event/whipsaw around the holiday session to mixed overnight, with a brief trend-up classification at 06:00 UTC before the reversal.
outlookSummary: Current low-holding and aligned oil/VIX/yield pressure lift Tail into the elevated band, while strong semiconductor breadth limits conviction. The principal future checkpoint is the first post-holiday U.S. cash open; repair away from the low can reduce Tail quickly.
